name: oh-my-bash + ble.sh
description: Installs oh-my-bash (theme/prompt framework) and ble.sh (Bash line editor providing autosuggestions, auto-complete and syntax highlighting) into the remote user's home, and wires dev's .bashrc: ble.sh source --attach=none first, oh-my-bash second, ble-attach last, matching the upstream integration guide. Set a version option to an empty string to skip that tool.

ohMyBashVersion.description: Git ref (branch, tag or commit) of ohmybash/oh-my-bash to clone. Empty string skips installation.

bleVersion.description: ble.sh release tag (the prebuilt ble-<version-without-v>.tar.xz asset is extracted into ~/.local/share/blesh). Empty string skips installation.
